title: When the Smile Sings
author: L. M. Amberdale
blurb: Quentin Dravenmoor, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
